card.name: Start of osteonecrosis and osteo- words
card.fires_on: The 'oste' or 'ste' piece at the start of bone-condition words such as osteonecrosis, osteosarcoma and osteitis, especially in jaw osteonecrosis warnings. Also fires on a space or slash between strengths in amoxicillin-clavulanate dose lists.

modes.label: Bone-condition words
modes.description: The first piece of osteonecrosis, osteosarcoma or osteitis in warnings and section headings.

modes.label: Strength separators
modes.description: A space or slash between paired amoxicillin and clavulanate strengths.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward finishing the long bone-condition word, with no clear link to the listed tokens.
card.plain: It lights up at the start of bone-disease words like osteonecrosis, and also at the divider in paired amoxicillin-clavulanate strengths.
